_note: Q142(h), M11's heat registration: the machine-readable copy of REGISTRATION.md's numbers. Written before any M11 hold, any M11 fit and any pool-8 (E171-E174) data. Design figures come from design-power-heat.json (design_power_heat.py); nothing here is fitted.

per_hold.R: measured plateau rise over the hold's anchor (mean over [b - 300 s, b), anchor = last 120 s of the rest before the hold)
per_hold.P: Q138(t)'s frozen chain on the session's measured board trace (arm A), read the same way

a_heat_over_minutes.fit: ordinary least squares per session on its scored holds; nothing shared between sessions or card kinds

test_HM_LG.groups: the card kind's M11 hold sessions
test_HM_LG.reported: HM-LG pooled over both card kinds with e and P divided by the card kind's sigma

reading_HM_E144.verdict: E144 REPEATS (inside in every session that ran H_E) / DOES NOT REPEAT

reading_HM_HE.line: e(H_E) outside the 95% prediction interval (t at n_s - 3 df) of the two-term fit on the session's other scored holds

entry.GAIN_and_sessions_share: carry gamma_c = sum(e P) / sum(P^2) over the card kind's scored M11 holds if |gamma_c| >= 0.010 and its 95% interval excludes 0 and S7-W is not met
entry.LEVEL_and_sessions_share: carry abar_c = mean(e) over the card kind's scored M11 holds if |abar_c| >= 0.10 C and its 95% interval excludes 0 and S7-W is not met
entry.BOTH_and_sessions_share: carry both, fitted jointly (e = abar_c + gamma_c P), each by its own numbers above
entry.sessions_differ_or_NOT_SEPARATED: nothing enters; the chain unscaled stays M11's primary, the x1.032 arm reported
entry.one_session: k = 1: neither HM-AG nor S7-W can be read, so nothing enters the primary; the verdict and the constant are reported as a candidate labelled one session

not_wanted.S7_W: leave one M11 session out: with the term fitted on the card kind's other M11 sessions, the held-out session's rms over its scored holds rises by more than sigma_c / sqrt(n_s)
not_wanted.HE: HM-HE reads DEPARTS in every session that ran H_E
not_wanted.sign: a carried term's sign differs between the card kinds

aifoundry3.harness: E166's (run_e166.py, E97's natural chain, the 10 Hz 34-sensor sampler, the C-logging host)

holds.name: H_E
holds.pattern: E144's H_H (A1.1): --seconds 3.20 every 7.56 s (3.456 s recorded, share 0.4571) if R0's room <= 51.5 C; --seconds 2.60 every 7.98 s (2.965 s, share 0.3716) in (51.5, 53.0]

aifoundry3.gate_G0: R0's room (34-sensor mean, last 120 s) <= 53.0 C, else no hold starts
aifoundry3.stops: no launch at a firmware reading >= 70 C; a hold ends at any live sample >= 72 C (firmware or 34-sensor mean) or board >= 65 W; the pass ends at >= 74 C; E97's guards

aifoundry2.harness: E167's (run_e167.py over E80's run_kspeed.py and E64's run_hpl.py, E98's 15-minute rest, the C-logging host)
aifoundry2.clock: its own governor, 65 W / 65 C as read, nothing set

holds.name: Z_m
holds.item: int8.neg_ones on shires mask 0x11111111 (8 of 32: every fourth shire by number)

aifoundry2.each_hold_blocks: REST (start: cool, max_c 49, max_wait_s 240; 120 s anchor) + HOLD + END (120 s)
aifoundry2.regime: 800 MHz only: the hold is scored if at least 90% of its window's samples read >= 790 MHz
aifoundry2.stops: die >= 72 C on one live sample; board > 80 W on 3 consecutive live samples; every hold's predicted peak <= 82 W

b_holds.card0: not designed: no frozen heat chain exists for aifoundry1 card 0 (or card 1), so a hold there has no chain miss to test
b_holds.never_beside: E171-E174 (pool 8's card day): M11's sessions run after them, on their own claims, runs and directories

c_card1_heat_scale_HC1.form: on aifoundry1 card 1 only: dT_win = h1(s) * M10's 4.5 s law (H2_per_card_runlength, m10.json heat_4p5s, refitted per fold) at the item's measured S and run length; h1(s) = median over the session's random anchors (M10 REGISTRATION section 3a's set and pool 8's scale anchors, both families; check and zeros anchors never) of dT_win / the law; aifoundry3 keeps h = 1
c_card1_heat_scale_HC1.rows: M10's heat rows (fit_m7.heat_rows' rule with E141, E142, E153, E157, E163, E164): card 1's 448 judged, aifoundry3's 484 reported

entry.interval: 95% paired bootstrap over kinds (2,000 draws, seed 142) below 0
entry.sessions: d <= 0 in at least 2/3 of card 1's sessions with >= 10 heat rows
entry.bias: card 1's heat bias does not change sign and grow in size

not_wanted: HC1-B reads WORSE on a new card-1 session
h1 over-corrects on a new card-1 session's N1 (its bias changes sign and grows)

blind_reading_HC1_B.session: E172 (pool 8 on card 1), only if this commit precedes E172's first launch
blind_reading_HC1_B.statistic: rms(dT_win - h1 law) - rms(dT_win - law), paired bootstrap over the tiles, 20,000 draws, seed 80,000 + the character codes of 'M11-HC1-B'

d_card1_paired_anchor_int8_I8P.form: k(s, r) = median over the int8 random anchors a run in both the card-1 session s and its paired aifoundry3 session r of [D_s(a) / Dhat_s(a)] / [D_r(a) / Dhat_r(a)], Dhat = M10's int8 B at the session's measured rate (card term 0.9616 on card 1); card 1's int8 prediction in s = k * M10's

entry.interval: 95% paired bootstrap over kinds (2,000 draws, seed 142) below 0
entry.pool7: E164's priority-1 int8 bias falls in size and keeps its sign
entry.all_card1_int8: the rms over every card-1 int8 row rises by no more than 0.001 W

not_wanted: it over-corrects (the bias changes sign and grows) on E164's int8 rows or over the paired sessions' card-1 int8 rows
the pairs' k agree with 1 within the anchors' own errors (sd of k over pairs no larger than the sd from D + se N(0,1), 2,000 draws, seed 142)

blind_reading_I8P_B.sessions: E172 with E171 (pool 8's pair), only if this commit precedes both first launches
blind_reading_I8P_B.statistic: paired bootstrap as HC1-B, seed 80,000 + the character codes of 'M11-I8P-B'

card_time_needed.aifoundry3: 2 sessions x 74.7 card-minutes (149.4; cap 152), different days, rested card
card_time_needed.aifoundry2: optional: 2 sessions x about 58 protocol card-minutes (up to 74 with the gate waits; about 105-120 minutes held each with the 15-minute rests)
card_time_needed.minimum: one aifoundry3 session (74.7 card-minutes): HM-LG-A3 at df (1, 3)
